result.topic_en: Calculations of first and second x-derivatives of a quantity t expressed through \varepsilon^{\pm 1/2}\alpha_1, \alpha_2 and \log\varepsilon, a related differential identity for t and t', an equality of two integrals, exponent matching for a hypergeometric-type integral, and an integration-by-parts identity for solutions of $\partial^2 u/\partial p\partial q + u = 0$.
